answer: According to the staff handbook, fridges must stay at 5°C or below. They should be checked and logged at opening and at 14:00. If a fridge reads between 5°C and 8°C, move the stock to another fridge and check again after 30 minutes. If it reads above 8°C for more than 2 hours, throw the stock away and call your manager. [food-safety.md]
